mappings.note: Orders seven algebraic observations and equates the 4th to 4. Positional median, LO-3, not a mean or mode calculation.
Reads the median off the abscissa of the two ogives' crossing point. Graphical route, C-8.2-LO-1, not the tabular LO-3.
Modal-class formula on a grouped table. LO-2.
Substitutes median and mean into Mode = 3 Median - 2 Mean. No modal class exists, so LO-2 would misdescribe it; the empirical relation has no LO of its own.
The expenditure of the maximum number of workers is the mode, found by the modal-class formula. LO-2 despite the word 'average' in the stem.
Deviation-sum identity of the direct-method mean formula. LO-1.
Differences a less-than table purely to find the largest class frequency. Target is the modal class, so LO-2 rather than LO-3.
Needs the median class from cumulative frequency and the modal class from maximum frequency, then sums their lower limits. Both outcomes are required.
Applies the continuity correction to inclusive classes, then locates N/2. The correction serves the median class, so LO-3.
Modal class from a below-type table; only the maximum frequency matters. LO-2.
Names the central tendency given by the ogive intersection. The graphical-median outcome, C-8.2-LO-1.
Median class via N/2 = 33.5 and modal class via maximum frequency 20 must be found separately even though both are 125-145. Two outcomes.
Sums frequencies up to 14.6 s, i.e. reads a less-than cumulative total, without reaching a median. LO-3 is the only outcome naming cumulative frequency.
Derives Mode - Mean = 9 from Median - Mean = 3 through the empirical relation. Spans all three measures, no single-measure computation.
Recovers a class frequency by differencing a more-than cumulative table. Cumulative-frequency handling; no curve is plotted, so not C-8.2-LO-1.
Cumulative frequencies then N/2 = 26 names the median class 1700-1850. LO-3.
Rearranges the empirical relation to get the median from mode and mean. No cumulative frequency is used, so LO-3 would misdescribe the method.
Median class from cumulative frequency with N/2 = 50. LO-3.
Part (i) differences a more-than cumulative table (LO-3); part (ii) computes a class mark, the mean methods' representative value (LO-1). Two separate skills in one item.
Solves the empirical relation for the mean from mode and median. No grouped-mean method is used, so competency level rather than LO-1.
Mean of a short raw list. Direct-method mean, LO-1; no frequency table, ordering or modal reasoning.
Full direct-method grouped mean: class marks, f*x column, Sum f x / Sum f. The core case of LO-1.
Modal-class formula on a grouped table giving mode 65. LO-2.
Inverts the modal-class formula to recover a missing frequency from a given mode. Still mode machinery, so LO-2 not LO-1.
Full median formula l + ((N/2 - F)/f) h after building cumulative frequencies. The textbook case of LO-3.
